tasks.label: Fetch Remotes and Show Branches
tasks.command: bash -lc 'git -C /opt/homebrew fetch --all --prune >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Fetched remotes." && git -C /opt/homebrew for-each-ref --format="%(refname:short)" refs/remotes/origin | grep -v "origin/HEAD" | head -n 50'

tasks.label: Simple Fetch
tasks.command: bash -lc "git -C /opt/homebrew fetch --all --prune >/dev/null 2>&1; echo 'Fetched remotes'; git -C /opt/homebrew for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin | grep -v 'origin/HEAD' | head -n 20"
